snippet.title: AGNI: Village of Calamity - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Agni is an investigator from a secret agency who defies orders to search for her missing partner in the forbidden village of Desa Purba. This cinematic survival horror game is inspired by Indonesian slasher films and pays tribute to Resident Evil and Silent Hill with a fixed hybrid camera and relentless stalker enemies. It's published by Wired Productions and coming to PS5, Xbox Series and PC in 2026.
